The '''Old Loggers' Hill cemetery''' was a cemetery located in [[Point Ueda]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]]. The city was built on the slope of a hill on one of Ueda's archipelagos and the cemetery was located around half way up outside the built up areas. Ueda once served as the site of a lucrative logging operation based on the valuable [[Ueda conifer]] [[tree]] and Point Ueda housed the operation's administrative offices and was home to the operation's mill workers.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> the logging and milling operation on Ueda had ended<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> but the cemetery remained.<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Old Loggers' Hill cemetery appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> It was then identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
